name: COMP_042
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (59%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
The reliability check flagged this image, and Invasive (38%) is also in the 90% conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 59%, Invasive 38% | Close; InSitu leads |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.63; 78th percentile | Flagged; input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Models disagree on top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 InSitu | Supports InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Largest concept term toward invasive carcinoma · Validated (19/20)
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak (18/20)
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 0, 1, 4) · context · Descriptive only; concept model gives negative term · Weak (8/20)
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Small positive term; spot check poor · Unreliable (3/20)
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 4, 6) · ↑ invasive · Small positive term; spot check failed · Unreliable (0/20)

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier use. Necrosis and mitoses are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Image quality is the problem: reliability is flagged, so the probabilities may not hold.
- MUSK disagrees, and InSitu leads Invasive only narrowly (59% vs 38%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 3**: Look for stromal invasion versus duct-confined growth.
2. **Regions 8, 9, 10**: Confirm benign glands and duct-confined atypia; the model scores these low-risk.
3. **Regions 1, 5, 6**: Verify necrosis and mitoses by eye; model spot checks were poor.
